name: treats the account whose sign-in the file holds as in place, and as active once the running client has signed in

steps.title: Close the Riot Client
steps.detail: Skipped: RiotClientServices.exe is not running.

steps.title: Save this account's sign-in
steps.detail: RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml holds Main's sign-in but it differs from the saved copy (no copy yet), so store the file, encrypted, as the account's saved sign-in. Nothing in the client's files changes.

steps.title: Back up RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml
steps.detail: Skipped: the file will not be modified.

steps.title: Put the account's sign-in in place
steps.detail: No change: RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml already holds Main's sign-in (fingerprint acd093bd).

steps.title: Start the Riot Client
steps.detail: Start the client with no arguments, as its own shortcut does. It signs in as riot_main on its own from the saved sign-in.

steps.title: Wait for the client to come up
steps.detail: Poll the process list until RiotClientServices.exe is running, up to 0.04 s.

steps.title: Confirm the client signed in
steps.detail: Read what the client appends to its new run log (no tokens in it) until it reports a sign-in verdict, up to 0.04 s: the signed-in state (PendingProductContext), after which RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml names the Riot account id, which must be …1111; or the login page (PendingLoginStrategy), which hands over to you in the next step. Only an invalid_grant refusal marks the saved copy stale.

steps.title: Wait for you to sign in
steps.detail: Runs only if the client refuses the saved sign-in or does not sign in within 0.04 s. The client stays on its login page; you sign in there once as riot_main with “Stay signed in” ticked and One Launch continues as soon as the log reports the sign-in, up to 0.0013333333333333333 min.

steps.title: Save the new sign-in
steps.detail: Runs only after a manual sign-in: the fresh sign-in replaces the stale saved copy.

notes: The Riot Client already holds Main's sign-in, so it is only started.

steps.title: Close the Riot Client
steps.detail: Send RiotClientServices.exe a window close and wait up to 0.04 s; a process that ignores the close is ended on its own, never with its children: a running game would refuse the switch before this step. Then the same for the window processes it leaves behind (Riot Client.exe).

steps.title: Save this account's sign-in
steps.detail: After the client has closed, read RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml and, if it holds Main's sign-in and it changed, store the file, encrypted, as the account's saved sign-in. Nothing in the client's files changes.
